newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Creditanstalt sees 1996 dividend at 11-13 ATS.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt sees 1996 dividend at 11-13 ATS.

text.p: Creditanstalt supervisory board head Walther Fremuth said on Friday the bank would pay a 1996 dividend of between 11 and 13 schillings per share after 10 schillings a year ago, a bank spokeswoman said.
"It will be between 11 and 13 schillings, but the final decision will be made at next week's supervisory board meeting," she told Reuters.
The bank is due to present final 1996 results on Wednesday.
According to preliminary figures, group operating profit rose to 6.2 billion schillings from 6.138 a year earlier. Net profit was up at 2.6 billion schillings, up from 2.2 billion in 1995.
Bank Austria in January acquired majority control of Creditanstalt, its closest competitor, for 17.2 billion schillings.
